observation_summary: The DelegatingMethod.equals() and hashCode() methods were implemented incorrectly, causing equality checks to fail even when comparing an object to itself or to another DelegatingMethod instance.
reasoning_summary: The fix involves rewriting the logic within the equals() and hashCode() methods to correctly handle object identity, instances of the same class, and delegation to the underlying method. This is a procedural correction of the equality logic, which fits the Algorithm/Method category as it corrects the computational strategy for determining object equality.
evidence_used: The bug report states that DelegatingMethod.equals() failed when comparing to itself or another DelegatingMethod.

The fix_diff_oracle shows the addition of identity checks (this == o), type checks (instanceof DelegatingMethod), and a change to the hashCode() implementation from a constant (1) to the underlying method's hash code.
The fix modifies the internal procedural logic of the equals and hashCode methods.

alternative_types.why_not_primary: The fix is not just about setting a value, but about implementing the correct logic for equality comparison and hash code generation.
While the fix adds checks (instanceof), these are part of the overall algorithmic logic for determining equality, not just a missing guard for a parameter.
